format.value: kid pitch, and at ball four a coach pitches to that batter (4 coach pitches; no walks); official hardball; an inning ends at 3 outs, 5 runs, or once through the batting order; one base on an error; no infield fly and no dropped-third-strike; no stealing in the first half of the season, then only on passed balls, wild pitches or a dropped return throw, never home; no mercy rule (play to the time limit); 90 minutes or 6 innings; score kept, playoffs end the season

format.history: 2023 (AA rules thread in the umpires-and-managers group, confirmed by the AA coordinator): the same core rules (coach pitches after ball four, 5 runs or the lineup ends a half-inning, 1 base on an error, no mercy rule, no infield fly, 90 minutes), but no stealing at all, and a hit batter could take first or keep batting. The official 2024 version (General Rules for NCLL AA Baseball - 2024, linked by the 2024 umpire coordinators) has the same rules: no stealing unless the coaches agree to allow it in the second half, never steal home, a hit batter may take first or keep batting, and a catcher with 3 innings + 1 pitch can't pitch.

teamFormation.value: Friends are the starting point for team formation, with a disclaimer: one or two close friends can usually be honored, not a whole class or birthday-party list.
teamFormation.placed: Tee Ball through AA (and softball A, AA): teams are mostly friend groups and often move up together; siblings same team; schoolmates next.
teamFormation.draft: AAA and Majors: drafted for balance. If a player lands on a team with no friends or schoolmates, a swap with a same-level player puts them with buddies; done on draft day; rosters are set before coaches leave the draft (a move afterward counts as a draft-day failure). The league also values kids making new friends.
teamFormation.siblings: Same team unless the family asks otherwise (some have asked for different teams).
teamFormation.coachChildren: Treated like a sibling: placed on the parent's team in the round their assessment score/rating earns; the coach forgoes that round's pick.
teamFormation.girlsInBaseball: Baseball is open to girls at every level; families choose. State it neutrally: NCLL does not recruit girls to baseball (softball's domain).
teamFormation.teamSize: Usually 11-14 players per team, Tee Ball through Majors, both sports; Juniors is one larger team.
